title: Grateful Dead Live at Downs of Santa Fe on 1983-09-10
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: (FOB) 2 x Nakamichi CM700 => Sony TC-D5m >> MAC (3 x Maxell UDXLII C90's)

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with hot live sound and a bass‑forward mix captures an excellent performance.
ai_review.review: The audience tape delivers a hot, lively sound that highlights the low end, giving the show a bass‑happy character. Reviewers praised the overall performance as solid and enjoyable, noting no major flaws. The recording is considered exceptional for an AUD source.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one five‑star review; both the show and the audience recording are praised highly, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hot live sound with a strong bass presence; clear enough for an audience source, no reported distortion or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance described as solid and energetic; no specific pacing issues mentioned.
